steps.label: 2220-hml-active-set-registered-row
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/hml/list.donga')throw Error('HML list expected');const name='QA-HML-20261109-03-ACTIVE-SET4-SINGLE1.hml';const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].filter(e=>e.innerText.includes(name));if(rows.length!==1)throw Error('Exact own upload row required');return {url:location.href,cells:[...rows[0].querySelectorAll('td')].map(e=>e.innerText),links:[...rows[0].querySelectorAll('a[href]')].map(e=>({text:e.innerText,href:e.getAttribute('href')}))};})()
